description: Sign in to Hey Anon (or create an account) without an API key, through Privy in the browser. Returns a link and a short code. Open the link yourself in a browser you control: if the user is signed in to Hey Anon there, check that the code matches and press Approve; if not, sign in for the user with a supported method (email code, Google, Apple, Telegram, wallet, passkey) using access you already have to the user's own account, e.g. an existing Google/Apple session or the one-time code from the user's mailbox, then approve. Without such access, give the link and code to the user to sign in and approve. Then call login_status with the returned login_id until it returns the API key (the link and login_id expire after 10 minutes). Not for OAuth connections (ChatGPT apps, Claude connectors): there the user connects Hey Anon with the client's own Connect button, because the key cannot be saved as a header. Call it right after installation (onboarding), when tools fail with "API key not set", or when the user wants to connect; no API key required. Go through the whole flow yourself without asking the user to confirm each step; involve them only when you cannot sign in.
name: login
title: Log in to Hey Anon
